- [NMET.1.2] **Delivery is a typed integrator callback.**
  The integrator registers one `ds_metric_cb_t` per engine
  with `ds_engine_set_metric_callback`. The engine must
  invoke it once per occurrence, with a `ds_metric_t`
  (name, kind, value, labels), and must not buffer, sample
  or rate-limit emissions. What becomes of the value is
  the callback's choice. This is the [IARC.1.14]
  invariant: every external service is an integrator
  callback.
